signaling_summary: Pure digital protocol: synchronous CMOS single-ended signals; rising-edge sampling on ACLK; no analog content.

ARM AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022)

fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
fields.rationale: AXI/ACE is a purely digital, synchronous on-chip bus protocol. There are no analog signals, no DC electrical specifications, no AC timing parameters, no IO standards.

signaling_summary.clock: Single ACLK per ACE interface; rising-edge sampled.
signaling_summary.reset: Single active-LOW ARESETn. Async assert, sync deassert.
signaling_summary.io_count: All AXI + ACE channels are unidirectional. No tri-state, no open-drain, no analog.
signaling_summary.default_state_during_reset: Master drives ARVALID/AWVALID/WVALID/CRVALID/CDVALID LOW; interconnect drives RVALID/BVALID/ACVALID LOW.
signaling_summary.combinatorial_path_rule: No combinatorial paths between input and output signals. Applies equally to AC/CR/CD snoop channels.
